recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-26543 across the current build's active ModelInfo surface while preserving the already-correct datatype source and later period/standards-status decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-26543 was Published/Persuasive for BR&R and requested ProductShelfLife improvements for R5: remove the legacy identifier, make type optional, make period[x] a string-or-duration/quantity choice and optional after friendly amendment, and correct ownership/maturity metadata away from Pharmacy/ML3.
initial_application: Commit 06292b1b26ffdcd194174e1ca60da619e39ae790 applied the structural datatype changes in source/datatypes/productshelflife.xml by removing ProductShelfLife.identifier, making type 0..1, and changing period to optional period[x] Quantity|string. Later FHIR-31802 work changed the period choice to Duration|string and an existing combined-branch AutoFHIR commit aligned the period ModelInfo surface. The remaining stale seed application was that ModelInfo still exposed ProductShelfLife.identifier.
additional_context: ProductShelfLife is active in source/fhir.ini and now shows BR&R ownership. Its current Normative status came from a later R6-wide normative-status change, so this reconciliation did not revert that later decision. publish.ini publishes the FHIR ModelInfo content file and the Library resource embeds the same content for CQL tooling. FHIR-28255 confirms the current Duration|string period target, while FHIR-35961 is only R4B branch compatibility background.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to remove ProductShelfLife.identifier and regenerated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so the embedded data matches the content file. No other ProductShelfLife, PackagedProductDefinition, or DeviceDefinition source change was needed.

source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: refreshed the embedded base64 Library payload to match the updated ModelInfo content.
